claims.evidence: Photo 2 control panel clearly reads 'SHARP AR-9201', not AR-M201. Model identity is set by the witness's reading, not the seller's text.
Photos show only exterior/top views; general cosmetic wear can't be judged as 'fair' without closer shots of casing, rollers, and interior.
No power-on, copy output, or scan test shown; witness explicitly notes working condition is not shown.
Incomplete claim text, nothing in photos confirms readiness (no accessories, cables, or packaging shown).

risks.risk: Model mismatch between seller's stated model (AR-M201) and the model visible on the panel (AR-9201) could mean wrong unit, wrong listing, or swapped photos.
risks.proof: A fresh, unambiguous close-up of the control panel and rating label showing the model/serial number matching the unit being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the witness-identified model (AR-9201) only, and flag discrepancy; do not price based on seller's stated model.

risks.proof: Video of unit powering on and producing a test copy/print/scan.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-functional / for-parts worst case.

risks.risk: Unknown toner/drum consumable levels and condition.
risks.proof: Photo of opened toner/drum compartment showing consumable levels and part condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming consumables need full replacement.

risks.risk: Unknown page count / usage history, which affects remaining machine life.
risks.proof: Photo of the internal usage counter or maintenance/service sticker.

risks.risk: Missing trays, cables, feeder parts, or accessories not visible in all photos.
risks.proof: Full-unit photo showing all paper trays installed, power cable, and any document feeder attachments.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete unit requiring accessory purchase.

risks.risk: Hidden physical or internal damage (wiring, rollers, boards) not visible from exterior shots.
risks.proof: Photos of open side panels/interior and close-ups of rollers and wiring.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible internal damage, worst case.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the control panel and any rating/serial label confirming the exact model.
Video of the copier powering on and producing an actual copy/print.
Photo of the toner/drum compartment opened.
Photo of the internal page/usage counter if available.
Full photo showing all trays, cables, and accessories included in the sale.
Clarification of the seller's cut-off claim ('ready to...').
response.reason: The witness identifies the unit as a Sharp AR-9201 photocopier with open/unverified functional and consumable status, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified working condition, unknown consumables/usage) pending the listed proofs; the seller's conflicting model name (AR-M201) is contradicted by the photographed panel and should not be used to set identity or price.
